note: boot2-rewrite-excluded round 2: MemberRepository (excluded from the rewrite) extends only PagingAndSortingRepository, which no longer extends CrudRepository in Spring Data 3+ → save / findAll() / deleteById are gone; the script adds ListCrudRepository<T, ID> to the repository — L2 `compile|cannot_find_symbol|deleteById` (be86f0b7bd) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|save` (c54a8d68e2) / `compile|no_suitable_method|findAll` (68d2971144)
response:
<analysis>Spring Data 3 split the CRUD methods out of PagingAndSortingRepository: a repository that only extends it lost save / findAll() / deleteById. The errors name the repository type (variable … of type com.example.members.repository.MemberRepository); its source file was excluded from the OpenRewrite run. The script finds that interface and adds ListCrudRepository<T, ID> (same type arguments) next to PagingAndSortingRepository, so the CRUD methods (findAll() returning List) are back.</analysis>
<script>
import re

TYPE = re.compile(r"of type ([\w.]+)")
IMPORT = "import org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository;"


def fix(p):
    types = sorted({m.group(1) for e in p.errors for m in [TYPE.search(e.get("location") or "")] if m})
    if not types:
        p.log("no repository type named in the errors")
    for fqcn in types:
        hits = p.files("**/" + fqcn.replace(".", "/") + ".java")
        if not hits:
            p.log(f"{fqcn}: source not in the project")
            continue
        path = hits[0]
        text = p.read(path)
        decl = re.search(r"\binterface\s+\w+\s+extends\s+([^{]*)\{", text)
        if not decl or "PagingAndSortingRepository<" not in decl.group(1):
            p.log(f"{path}: no PagingAndSortingRepository in the extends clause")
            continue
        if re.search(r"\bCrudRepository<|\bListCrudRepository<|\bJpaRepository<", decl.group(1)):
            p.log(f"{path}: already extends a CRUD repository")
            continue
        clause = decl.group(1)
        args = re.search(r"PagingAndSortingRepository<([^>]+)>", clause).group(1)
        clause_new = clause.replace(f"PagingAndSortingRepository<{args}>",
                                    f"ListCrudRepository<{args}>, PagingAndSortingRepository<{args}>", 1)
        new = text[:decl.start(1)] + clause_new + text[decl.end(1):]
        if IMPORT not in new:
            new = new.replace("import org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository;",
                              IMPORT + "\nimport org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository;", 1)
        p.write(path, new)
        p.log(f"{path}: + ListCrudRepository<{args}> (Spring Data 3 CRUD methods)")
</script>
